args.message: North ranks first by revenue, followed by South, East and West. Revenue is the sum of all order amounts, including orders with status "bad". Orders were left out when their customer has no region or doesn't exist in the customer table. Credit limits are added up over all of each region's customers, whether or not they ordered. The one customer with no region (credit 500) isn't counted. The Arctic region has no customers or orders, so it doesn't appear.
